posts.author: Sean Gunner
posts.title: Re: Call of Duty Modern Warefare 2
posts.html:
If they released it for the PC at the same time then people who had an awesome PC would just buy it for the PC.
But if they release it for the XBOX 360 and the PS3 a couple of years before then people will get impatient and buy it for the XBOX 360 or PS3.
Also if they feel the need they might buy it on the PC as well.
Therefore they are actually making money by doing it this way so I wouldn't be suprised if that's why they do it.
To get a larger amount of people buying the game. Also it means their income will boom, reduce then boom again when it comes out for the PC.
